主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. (NYSE: "CLB US" and NYSE Euronext: "CLB NA") announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share of common stock for the third quarter of 2013. The dividend will be payable on August 19, 2013, to shareholders of record on July 19, 2013. Dutch withholding tax will be deducted at a rate of 15%. The company stated that future quarterly cash dividends will depend on its financial position, earnings, earnings outlook, capital expenditure plans, share repurchases, acquisition opportunities, and other relevant factors. Core Laboratories N.V. operates in the Oil & Gas Services industry, offering reservoir description, production enhancement, and reservoir management services globally, with over 70 offices in more than 50 countries.
